line.comment: * SCRIPT NAME: Mayhem.BlackMarket.CreateShip
* DESCRIPTION: Creates a Black Market ship from the predetermined purchase registry.
* Returns the abandoned ship or null.
* $class: requested ship class.
* Expanded 2.2: Ship type, sector, position, and protection offset are predetermined.
* Entries in the player's current sector are skipped, not consumed.
* Herobetty 5.4: Retrieve the predetermined ship registry.
* See Mayhem.Init.BlackMarket for the ship registry.
* Find the next eligible entry without consuming skipped entries.
* A purchased ship cannot spawn in the player's current sector.
* Skip this entry and examine the next one.
* Extract the predetermined properties.
* Validate the entry before creating the ship.
* Zero is a valid offset.
* Create the abandoned ship using predetermined values.
* The absolute protection deadline starts at spawn time.
* Consume the entry only after successful ship creation.
* Expanded 2.2: Replenish only if the remaining financing budget can accommodate every existing entry plus one replacement.
* The purchase has not yet been added to mayhem_yakiFinancing.
* Include the purchase currently being processed.
* Calculate the total cost of the registry after replenishment.
* Replenish only if the replacement fits within the remaining budget.
* Debug: Confirm which predetermined entry was purchased.
* No eligible entry was found.
